name: What questions should I ask before starting a bathroom remodel in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before starting a bathroom remodel in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before starting a bathroom remodel in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodels look simple but can go wrong quickly if the details are not settled upfront. Ask who is responsible for waterproofing, how the shower system will be built, whether ventilation will be upgraded, and whether plumbing fixtures will stay in place or move. You should also ask how long the room will be out of service, what the realistic sequence is, and whether permits are needed for your exact scope. Tile, stone, and specialty fixtures often have longer lead times than homeowners expect, so ordering strategy matters. In Los Angeles, older bathrooms may also hide water damage, bad previous repairs, or outdated plumbing that can affect the plan once demolition starts. A contractor should explain how these risks are handled and whether they are included in the bid or treated as possible change orders. The more detailed the answers are before work begins, the less likely the project is to stall later. Bathrooms are compact, but they require disciplined planning to avoid expensive mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, waterproofing, ventilation, plumbing layout, tile lead times, timeline, and who handles inspections. Bathrooms are small projects with high risk if details are missed.
